You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 123e495ecc25d32cf3e7958f794013236abdf0d4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2021 21:19:55 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: linkwatch: be more careful about
 dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker

Apparently a concurrent linkwatch_add_event() could
run while we are in __linkwatch_run_queue().

We need to free dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker tracker
under lweventlist_lock protection to avoid this race.

syzbot report:
[   77.935949][ T3661] reference already released.
[   77.941015][ T3661] allocated in:
[   77.944482][ T3661]  linkwatch_fire_event+0x202/0x260
[   77.950318][ T3661]  netif_carrier_on+0x9c/0x100
[   77.955120][ T3661]  __ieee80211_sta_join_ibss+0xc52/0x1590
[   77.960888][ T3661]  ieee80211_sta_create_ibss.cold+0xd2/0x11f
[   77.966908][ T3661]  ieee80211_ibss_work.cold+0x30e/0x60f
[   77.972483][ T3661]  ieee80211_iface_work+0xb70/0xd00
[   77.977715][ T3661]  process_one_work+0x9ac/0x1680
[   77.982671][ T3661]  worker_thread+0x652/0x11c0
[   77.987371][ T3661]  kthread+0x405/0x4f0
[   77.991465][ T3661]  ret_from_fork+0x1f/0x30
[   77.995895][ T3661] freed in:
[   77.999006][ T3661]  linkwatch_do_dev+0x96/0x160
[   78.004014][ T3661]  __linkwatch_run_queue+0x233/0x6a0
[   78.009496][ T3661]  linkwatch_event+0x4a/0x60
[   78.014099][ T3661]  process_one_work+0x9ac/0x1680
[   78.019034][ T3661]  worker_thread+0x652/0x11c0
[   78.023719][ T3661]  kthread+0x405/0x4f0
[   78.027810][ T3661]  ret_from_fork+0x1f/0x30
[   78.042541][ T3661] 
diff --git a/net/core/link_watch.c b/net/core/link_watch.c
index d7d089963b1d..b0f5344d1185 100644
--- a/net/core/link_watch.c
+++ b/net/core/link_watch.c
@@ -166,7 +166,10 @@ static void linkwatch_do_dev(struct net_device *dev)
 
 		netdev_state_change(dev);
 	}
-	dev_put_track(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
+	/* Note: our callers are responsible for
+	 * calling netdev_tracker_free().
+	 */
+	dev_put(dev);
 }
 
 static void __linkwatch_run_queue(int urgent_only)
@@ -209,6 +212,10 @@ static void __linkwatch_run_queue(int urgent_only)
 			list_add_tail(&dev->link_watch_list, &lweventlist);
 			continue;
 		}
+		/* We must free netdev tracker under
+		 * the spinlock protection.
+		 */
+		netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
 		spin_unlock_irq(&lweventlist_lock);
 		linkwatch_do_dev(dev);
 		do_dev--;
@@ -232,6 +239,10 @@ void linkwatch_forget_dev(struct net_device *dev)
 	if (!list_empty(&dev->link_watch_list)) {
 		list_del_init(&dev->link_watch_list);
 		clean = 1;
+		/* We must release netdev tracker under
+		 * the spinlock protection.
+		 */
+		netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
 	}
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&lweventlist_lock, flags);
 	if (clean)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/core/link_watch.c`**
   - **Line 166**: The line `dev_put_track(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` was replaced with a comment indicating that callers are responsible for calling `netdev_tracker_free()` and a call to `dev_put(dev);`.
   - **Line 209**: Added a comment indicating that the netdev tracker must be freed under spinlock protection. The line `netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` was added before unlocking the spinlock.
   - **Line 232**: Similar to line 209, a comment was added to indicate that the netdev tracker must be released under spinlock protection, and the line `netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` was added before unlocking the spinlock.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `link_watch.c` are aimed at addressing a race condition that could occur when `linkwatch_add_event()` is called concurrently with `__linkwatch_run_queue()`. By ensuring that the freeing of `dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker` occurs under the protection of `lweventlist_lock`, the patch prevents potential use-after-free errors. The changes also clarify the responsibilities of the callers regarding the management of the netdev tracker, ensuring that the code is safer and more maintainable.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
dev_put_track(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
```
```c
netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
```
```c
linkwatch_add_event();
```
Reason:
The bug occurs due to a race condition where `linkwatch_add_event()` can be executed concurrently while `__linkwatch_run_queue()` is processing. This can lead to `dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker` being freed prematurely while it is still being accessed, resulting in a use-after-free scenario.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
```
```c
spin_lock_irq(&lweventlist_lock);
```
Reason:
The fix ensures that `netdev_tracker_free()` is called under the protection of `lweventlist_lock`, preventing concurrent access to `dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker` while it is being freed. This synchronization avoids the race condition that leads to the premature release of the tracker.

This means that while `linkwatch_do_dev(dev)` is executing, another thread could potentially modify `dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker`, leading to a use-after-free scenario if `dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker` is released prematurely.
